NY A4195 — NY Creates New Program to Help Families Find Dementia Care

New York is launching a new program called NY Connects to help families and caregivers find information and support for Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia. The program will provide objective details about long-term care options, including home and community-based services, to consumers, caregivers, and their families. ...
